claims.statement: For every star T=K_{1,m} with m>=4 and every p satisfying x(T)+2<=p and 3p<2 alpha(T)+1, all m original leaves are favorable and S(T,p)=m*(binom(m-1,p)-binom(m-1,p-1))<0.
claims.scope: Exact symbolic proof for the star subfamily of the registered lower-region ordinary favorable-leaf aggregate; no conclusion for trees outside this family.
claims.reason: The star independence polynomial is (1+z)^m+z; the first descent, eligibility bounds, every strict favorable-leaf test, each original-leaf summand, multiplicity, and the zero-extended endpoint are checked explicitly in the report.

limitations: The registered global lower-region aggregate for arbitrary finite ordinary trees remains unresolved by this result.
No proof of the optional bipartite tagged-incidence identity or its global deficit budget is supplied.
